pairs.target: shítáng lǐ yòu diǎn qǐ le liǎngpái dēng .
pairs.english: Two rows of lamps were lit again in the dining hall.
pairs.hanzi: 食堂里又点起了两排灯。

pairs.target: yuánběn shōu hǎo de chángdèng bèi tuōchūlái , kèrén zuò yìbiān , xuéshēng zuò lìngyìbiān ,
pairs.english: Benches that had been put away were dragged out, with visitors on one side and students on the other.
pairs.hanzi: 原本收好的长凳被拖出来，客人坐一边，学生坐另一边，

pairs.target: rèshuǐ cóng hòu chú yì hú jiē yì hú dì sòng .
pairs.english: Hot water came from the kitchen one pot after another.
pairs.hanzi: 热水从后厨一壶接一壶地送。

pairs.target: yǒurén hái zài zhǎo tóng lái de rén , yǒurén xián wàiyī luò zài gōngfáng , rǎng zhe yào qǔ .
pairs.english: Some people were still looking for their companions; others complained about coats left in the workshop and demanded to fetch them.
pairs.hanzi: 有人还在找同来的人，有人嫌外衣落在工房，嚷着要取。

pairs.target: ménkǒu de lǎoshī jìxià yīfu yánsè , què búràng rén huíqù .
pairs.english: The instructor at the door noted the clothes' colors but would not let anyone return.
pairs.hanzi: 门口的老师记下衣服颜色，却不让人回去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ shèngxià de bǐng bāo hǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi wrapped up the remaining bread.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把剩下的饼包好。

pairs.target: pà wò gěi tā dǎoshuǐ shí , tīngjiàn línzhuō yǒurén shuō dēngjià shì tōu le biérén de dōngxī pīnchūlái de , nánguài zhànbúzhù .
pairs.english: As Pavo poured him water, someone at the next table said the lamp stand had been cobbled together from stolen things; no wonder it couldn't stand properly.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃给他倒水时，听见邻桌有人说灯架是偷了别人的东西拼出来的，难怪站不住。

alignment.english: someone at the next table said

pairs.target: shuōhuà de shì yígè gāoniánjí xuéshēng , gāngcái yìzhí zài kàn lù tú .
pairs.english: The speaker was an older student who had been looking at the map the whole time.
pairs.hanzi: 说话的是一个高年级学生，刚才一直在看路图。

pairs.target: tèlún zuòzài kàoqiáng de dèngzǐ shàng , shǒubèi yíkuài hóng yìn , shì fàng shéng shí mó de , méiyǒu pò .
pairs.english: Teren sat on a bench against the wall, with a red mark on the back of his hand from lowering the cord; the skin had not broken.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦坐在靠墙的凳子上，手背一块红印，是放绳时磨的，没有破。

pairs.target: tā táitóu shuō dēngjià búshì zhànbúzhù , hòu bànjùhuà yān zài biérén de wèn shēng lǐ .
pairs.english: He looked up and said it wasn't that the lamp stand couldn't stand properly, but the rest of his words were drowned by other people's questions.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬头说灯架不是站不住，后半句话淹在别人的问声里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le tā yìyǎn , yòu dītóu kàn zìjǐ de bēizi .
pairs.english: Tavi glanced at him, then looked down at his own cup.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了他一眼，又低头看自己的杯子。

pairs.target: zhǐyào bù chū shēng , jiù búbì tì tā zuò shénme .
pairs.english: If he stayed silent, he need not do anything for him.
pairs.hanzi: 只要不出声，就不必替他做什么。

pairs.target: mǐlā hái zài ménwài péi sū yǐ zhǎo tóng lái de mèimei , zhuōbiān méiyǒu shuí děng zhe tā biǎotài .
pairs.english: Mira was still outside helping Suyi look for her younger sister, who had come along; nobody at the table was waiting for his opinion.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉还在门外陪苏苡找同来的妹妹，桌边没有谁等着他表态。

pairs.target: " lìng yìzhāng zhuōzi yě dòng le . " tā zhōngyú shuō .
pairs.english: “The other table moved too,” he finally said.
pairs.hanzi: “另一张桌子也动了。”他终于说。

pairs.target: nà xuéshēng zhuǎnguò liǎn , wèn shìbushì tā zuò de .
pairs.english: The student turned toward him and asked whether he had done it.
pairs.hanzi: 那学生转过脸，问是不是他做的。

pairs.target: yǒurén jiàn tā gāngcái bǎshǒu àn zài tiěpiàn shàng ,
pairs.english: Someone had seen him pressing his hands on the iron strips earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 有人见他刚才把手按在铁片上，

pairs.target: huà chuán guò liǎngzhāng zhuōzi , yǐjīng biànchéng xīnshēng zài gěi kèrén yǎn dà běnshì .
pairs.english: After the story passed across two tables, it had become a new student showing off great powers for visitors.
pairs.hanzi: 话传过两张桌子，已经变成新生在给客人演大本事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de ěrduo yíxià rè le . tā shuō búshì , yòu juéde zhège búshì tàiduǎn , xiàng lián zuò guò shìfàn yě yíbìng fǒurèn .
pairs.english: Tavi's ears burned at once. He said no, then felt that no was too short, as though it denied having demonstrated anything at all.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的耳朵一下热了。他说不是，又觉得这个不是太短，像连做过示范也一并否认。

pairs.target: tā bǎ bēizi tuīkāi , chóngxīn shuō zìjǐ pèng guò tiěpiàn , lǎoshī zhǔn de , zuò wán yǐjīng sōngshǒu xiūxi .
pairs.english: He pushed his cup away and explained again that he had touched the strips with the instructor's permission, then released them and rested when finished.
pairs.hanzi: 他把杯子推开，重新说自己碰过铁片，老师准的，做完已经松手休息。

pairs.target: hòulái xiān kànjiàn dēngjià dòng , zài yóu luò héng jiào tā kàn lìng yípiàn tiě huáng .
pairs.english: Later he had first seen the lamp stand move; then Lohen had called his attention to the other iron spring.
pairs.hanzi: 后来先看见灯架动，再由洛衡叫他看另一片铁簧。

pairs.target: " shuí zhīdào nǐ sōngshǒu le hái liú zhe shénme . " nà xuéshēng shuō .
pairs.english: “Who knows what you left behind after letting go,” the student said.
pairs.hanzi: “谁知道你松手了还留着什么。”那学生说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yìshí dá bú shànglái . tā quèshí liàn guò lí shǒu liú xiào , cǐkè shuō cóngláibú huì , biànshì sāhuǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi could not answer for a moment. He had indeed practiced hands-free residual effects; saying he had never been able to would be a lie.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维一时答不上来。他确实练过离手留效，此刻说从来不会，便是撒谎。

pairs.target: kě dāngshí méi zuò , yào zěnyàng ràng méi kàn de rén xiāngxìn , tā bù zhīdào .
pairs.english: But he had not done it then. He did not know how to convince someone who had not been watching.
pairs.hanzi: 可当时没做，要怎样让没看的人相信，他不知道。

pairs.target: luò héng duān zhe liǎngwǎn tāng huílái , bǎ qízhōng yìwǎn fàngdào tā miànqián , shuō jìlù zài zìjǐ yīdài lǐ .
pairs.english: Lohen returned carrying two bowls of soup, put one before him, and said the record was in his pocket.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡端着两碗汤回来，把其中一碗放到他面前，说记录在自己衣袋里。

pairs.target: zuìhòu yícì shìfàn zhīhòu , liǎngpiàn dōu huídào yuánlái de xiàn ;
pairs.english: After the last demonstration, both strips had returned to the original lines.
pairs.hanzi: 最后一次示范之后，两片都回到原来的线；

pairs.target: hēshuǐ yǐqián tā kànguò , pángbiān zuò bǐjiào de tiě huáng yě méiyǒu biàn .
pairs.english: He had checked before they drank water, and the iron spring beside them used for comparison had not changed either.
pairs.hanzi: 喝水以前他看过，旁边作比较的铁簧也没有变。

pairs.target: " wǒ kànjiàn de shì zhèxiē . " luò héng shuō , " búshì tā yìzhí pèng zhe . "
pairs.english: “That is what I saw,” Lohen said. “He wasn't touching them the whole time.”
pairs.hanzi: “我看见的是这些。”洛衡说，“不是他一直碰着。”

pairs.target: nà xuéshēng huán xiǎng wèn , jiǎn lǎoshī yǐjīng zǒu dào zhuōbiān ,
pairs.english: The student wanted to ask more, but Instructor Jian had reached the table.
pairs.hanzi: 那学生还想问，简老师已经走到桌边，

pairs.target: jiào shíjì kànjiàn de rén fēnbié dào lǐjiān shuō , qítārén xiān děng .
pairs.english: He asked those who had actually seen things to give separate accounts in the inner room and told the others to wait.
pairs.hanzi: 叫实际看见的人分别到里间说，其他人先等。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu dāngchǎng xuāngào shuí qīngbái , yě méi ràng tǎ wéi zhàn qǐlái āi shěn .
pairs.english: He neither declared anyone innocent on the spot nor made Tavi stand up to be interrogated.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有当场宣告谁清白，也没让塔维站起来挨审。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi què réng juéde měigè rén dōu zài kàn zìjǐ de shǒu .
pairs.english: Yet Tavi still felt that everyone was looking at his hands.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维却仍觉得每个人都在看自己的手。

pairs.target: lǐjiān píngshí fàngkōng liángdài , jīnwǎn nuóchū yìjiǎo bǎi le zhāng zhuōzi .
pairs.english: The inner room usually held empty grain sacks; tonight a corner had been cleared for a table.
pairs.hanzi: 里间平时放空粮袋，今晚挪出一角摆了张桌子。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zuò zhe , jiǎn lǎoshī zhàn zài ménpáng , zhǐ shàng yǐjīng jì le dēngjià fàngxià shā dài de cìxù .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey sat while Instructor Jian stood by the door. The sequence of lowering the sandbag from the lamp stand was already recorded on paper.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师坐着，简老师站在门旁，纸上已经记了灯架放下砂袋的次序。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wéndào mádài lǐ de mài wèi , tūrán fāxiànzìjǐ hěn è , gāngcái nà kǒu bǐng hái méi chī wán .
pairs.english: Smelling wheat in the sacks, Tavi suddenly realized he was very hungry; he had not finished his bread.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维闻到麻袋里的麦味，突然发现自己很饿，刚才那口饼还没吃完。

pairs.target: tā cóng shìfàn kāishǐ jiǎng . jiǎng dào tiě huáng zìjǐ xiàchén shí , wéi lǎoshī wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu kànjiàn tā gāng kāishǐ dòng .
pairs.english: He began with the demonstration. When he reached the spring sinking by itself, Instructor Vey asked whether he had seen it start to move.
pairs.hanzi: 他从示范开始讲。讲到铁簧自己下沉时，维老师问他有没有看见它刚开始动。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng le xiǎng , shuō méiyǒu , shì luò héng lā tā yǐhòu cái kànjiàn de .
pairs.english: He thought about it and said no: he had seen it only after Lohen tugged him.
pairs.hanzi: 他想了想，说没有，是洛衡拉他以后才看见的。

pairs.target: lǎoshī biàn bǎ " kāishǐ " liǎnggè zì huàdiào , huànchéng " kànjiàn shí ".
pairs.english: The instructor crossed out the word “started” and replaced it with “when seen.”
pairs.hanzi: 老师便把“开始”两个字划掉，换成“看见时”。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe nà dào héngxiàn , wèn shìbushì zìjǐ liúxià le xiàoyìng .
pairs.english: Tavi stared at the stroke and asked whether he had left an effect behind.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯着那道横线，问是不是自己留下了效应。

pairs.target: " nǐ yǒuméiyǒu zuò liú xiào ? " " méiyǒu . "
pairs.english: “Did you create a residual effect?” “No.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你有没有做留效？”
“没有。”

pairs.target: " nà jiù zhào nǐ zuò de shuō . wèishénme biànhuà , yào bǎ biéchù de qíngkuàng yìqǐ chá . "
pairs.english: “Then describe what you did. To understand why it changed, we must investigate what was happening elsewhere too.”
pairs.hanzi: “那就照你做的说。为什么变化，要把别处的情况一起查。”

pairs.target: tā shuō nà piàn dúlì tiě huáng méiyǒu zuòwéi tā de pèiduì cáiliào ,
pairs.english: She said the independent iron spring had not been one of his paired materials.
pairs.hanzi: 她说那片独立铁簧没有作为他的配对材料，

pairs.target: bùnéng zhī píng tā dòng le jiù shuō shì tā de liú xiào , yě bùnéng zhī píng tā shuō méiyǒu jiù tíngzhǐ jiǎnchá .
pairs.english: Its movement alone could not be called his residual effect, nor could they stop checking merely because he said he had done nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 不能只凭它动了就说是他的留效，也不能只凭他说没有就停止检查。

pairs.target: tāmen yǐjīng tōngzhī zhíshǒu de wéihù rényuán , jīnwǎn búzài kāigōng fáng .
pairs.english: They had notified the maintenance staff on duty, and the workshop would not reopen tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 他们已经通知值守的维护人员，今晚不再开工房。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , jiānbǎng réng jǐn .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, his shoulders still tense.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，肩膀仍紧。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng wèn nà dàodǐ shìbushì ānquán de xuéxiào , huà dào le zuǐbiān , què biànchéng zìjǐ de tiěpiàn míngtiān hái néng bunéng qǔ .
pairs.english: He wanted to ask whether this was a safe school after all, but the words that came out asked whether he could collect his iron strips tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 他想问那到底是不是安全的学校，话到了嘴边，却变成自己的铁片明天还能不能取。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī shuō xiànzài bùnéng , shuí de dōu bùnéng .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey said not now: nobody could.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师说现在不能，谁的都不能。

pairs.target: chūménshí tèlún zhèng děng zài wàimiàn . tā zhàn qǐlái , xiàng yàoshuō xièxiè , zuìhòu zhī wèn yǒuméiyǒu tídào dēngjià de jiājù .
pairs.english: Teren was waiting outside when he left. He rose as though to thank him, but in the end only asked whether the lamp stand's clamp had been mentioned.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时特伦正等在外面。他站起来，像要说谢谢，最后只问有没有提到灯架的夹具。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō tí le , zìjǐ méi kànqīng jiājù xiān dòng háishì dǐzuò xiān dùn .
pairs.english: Tavi said it had, but he hadn't seen clearly whether the clamp moved first or the base stopped first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说提了，自己没看清夹具先动还是底座先顿。

pairs.target: tèlún róu róu shǒubèi , méiyǒu yāoqiú tā gǎikǒu .
pairs.english: Teren rubbed the back of his hand without asking him to change his account.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦揉揉手背，没有要求他改口。

pairs.target: " jiè dōngxī de shì , bié gēn tāmen shuō chéng méi fāshēng . " tǎ wéi shuō . " wǒ zhīdào . "
pairs.english: “Don't tell them the borrowing never happened,” Tavi said. “I know.”
pairs.hanzi:
“借东西的事，别跟他们说成没发生。”塔维说。
“我知道。”

pairs.target: " kě gāngcái wǒ yě bù zhīdào shìbushì nǐ de cuò . "
pairs.english: “But I don't know whether what happened just now was your fault, either.”
pairs.hanzi: “可刚才我也不知道是不是你的错。”

pairs.target: tèlún wàng zhe tā , guò le yíhuìer nuókāi wèizhì , ràng tā cóng zhǎi ménbiān guòqù .
pairs.english: Teren looked at him, then after a while moved aside to let him pass the narrow doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦望着他，过了一会儿挪开位置，让他从窄门边过去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huídào tāngwǎn qián , mǐlā yǐjīng huílái , bǎ yíkuài jìnruǎn de miànbāo tuī gěi tā ,
pairs.english: When Tavi returned to his soup bowl, Mira was back and pushed a piece of softened bread toward him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回到汤碗前，米拉已经回来，把一块浸软的面包推给他，

pairs.target: méiyǒu wèn tā wèishénme tì tèlún shuōhuà .
pairs.english: She did not ask why he had spoken up for Teren.
pairs.hanzi: 没有问他为什么替特伦说话。

pairs.target: shítáng lìngyìtóu , yīwén zhèng tóng fùqīn zhēng yíjù huà .
pairs.english: At the other end of the dining hall, Iven was arguing over a sentence with his father.
pairs.hanzi: 食堂另一头，伊文正同父亲争一句话。

pairs.target: fùqīn tì jiēdàichù xiě le zàngào láikè de duǎn tiáo , shuō zhǎnshì yǐjīng píngwěn jiéshù .
pairs.english: His father had written a short notice for reception to give visitors, saying the display had concluded smoothly.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲替接待处写了暂告来客的短条，说展示已经平稳结束。

pairs.target: yīwén zhǐzhe běi gōngfáng de fāngxiàng , shuō nà búshì jiéshù , shì tíng le .
pairs.english: Iven pointed toward the north workshop and said it had not concluded; it had been stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文指着北工房的方向，说那不是结束，是停了。

pairs.target: shēngyīn bú dà , tǎ wéi gé zhe rén zhǐnéng tīngjiàn zhè liǎngjù .
pairs.english: Their voices were quiet, and through the crowd Tavi could hear only those two sentences.
pairs.hanzi: 声音不大，塔维隔着人只能听见这两句。

pairs.target: hòulái tiēchūlái de zhǐ xiě zhe zhǎnshì zàntíng , wèi fāxiàn rényuán shòushāng , yuányīn dàichá .
pairs.english: The paper posted later read: display suspended, no injuries found, cause under investigation.
pairs.hanzi: 后来贴出来的纸写着展示暂停，未发现人员受伤，原因待查。

pairs.target: fùqīn zhàn zài gàoshì páng huídá kèrén míngtiān zěnyàng qǔ dōngxī , yīwén gěi tā dì le yìbēi shuǐ .
pairs.english: His father stood by the notice, answering visitors' questions about collecting belongings tomorrow, and Iven handed him a cup of water.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲站在告示旁回答客人明天怎样取东西，伊文给他递了一杯水。

pairs.target: tā jiē le , liǎng rén méiyǒu zài zhēng .
pairs.english: He accepted it, and the two did not argue again.
pairs.hanzi: 他接了，两人没有再争。

pairs.target: shuì qián , xuéshēng shōudào míngtiān qù shítáng cè wū shàngkè de tōngzhī .
pairs.english: Before bed, students were told to attend class in the dining hall's side room tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 睡前，学生收到明天去食堂侧屋上课的通知。

pairs.target: pà wò bàoyuàn lí tāngguō tài jìn huì è , méi rén xiào dé hěn xiǎng .
pairs.english: Pavo complained that being so close to the soup pot would make him hungry. Nobody laughed very loudly.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃抱怨离汤锅太近会饿，没人笑得很响。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tuōyī shí cái fāxiàn jiānshàng cèng le yídào báihuī .
pairs.english: Only while undressing did Tavi notice a smear of white dust on his shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维脱衣时才发现肩上蹭了一道白灰。

pairs.target: tā pāi le jǐxià , huī luòdào chuángbiān , shǒuzhǐ háishì zìjǐ de shǒuzhǐ , liáng de , yǒudiǎn fā gān .
pairs.english: He brushed it a few times, and the dust fell beside the bed. His fingers were still his own fingers, cool and a little dry.
pairs.hanzi: 他拍了几下，灰落到床边，手指还是自己的手指，凉的，有点发干。
